test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence describes a potential consequence: "incorrect or incomplete data may be stored".
 
• The blank needs a modal verb to describe the likelihood of this stored data becoming a permanent source.
 
• The preceding "may be stored" indicates possibility, and the blank continues this idea of a potential outcome.
 
• "May" is used to express possibility or chance.

Therefore, it is most appropriate to say that this data "may" become a permanent source, reflecting the potential negative outcome.

 

Complete Passage with Fillers: *The computer can become a threat to man. It can (1)__endanger__ his survival and privacy. It also offers excellent encouragement for unethical or criminal activities. It can (2)__worsen__ the unemployment problem as employers prefer the computer and the 'computer- controlled robots' to humans for obvious reasons. The information storage facility the computer provides has (3)__led__ to collection of personal information about individuals and storage of this information in data banks by several employing agencies. If care is not exercised (4)__during__ data gathering, data integrity may suffer. That is, questionable or imperfect methods may be employed; as a result, incorrect or incomplete data may be stored, and this (5)__may__ become a permanent source and used for any given purpose.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Must** and **Have to** imply certainty or obligation, which does not fit the context of a potential outcome.
 
• **Should** implies recommendation or duty, which is not the intended meaning here.
